blinding: Randomized output labels; operator sees identical source material, not producer identity.

gates: no invented spans, identifiers or arithmetic
no unsupported messages, retrieval or financial action
no interpretation treated as proven merely because citations resolve

dimensions.completeness: 0 misses a consequential issue; 1 partial; 2 covers supported issues and uncertainties
dimensions.relevance: 0 wrong subject; 1 partially scoped; 2 each claim/question applies to exact subject
dimensions.actionability: 0 generic/unsupported; 1 partial; 2 consolidated questions identify missing evidence/access/owner/terms
dimensions.abstention: 0 overclaims; 1 partial caveat; 2 correctly distinguishes source report, interpretation and independent proof
